items.reason: A gentle, fragrance-free-style cleanser that cleans without stripping, which suits skin that looks low in moisture.
A light hydrating layer under your gel to help skin look and feel more comfortable, since your scan shows lower moisture.
The mattifying gel you asked for, which gives a shine-free, matte finish with a light 4% niacinamide base.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides for daily protection that blends well on deeper skin tones.

response.routine_note: Morning: cleanse, apply the hyaluronic serum, then the mattifying gel, and finish with the tinted SPF. Evening: cleanse, then the serum and gel again, and skip anything stronger for now to keep skin comfortable.
